read.en: Teradyne fell 6.8% on Nov 4 to $250.99, trading between $245.94 and $268.17. It is below the falling 5-day ($270.4), 10-day ($291.6), 30-day ($355.6) and 100-day ($371.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($350.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram roughly flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($292.08), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月4日下跌 6.8%，收于 $250.99，盘中区间 $245.94–268.17。股价位于下行的 5 日（$270.4）、10 日（$291.6）、30 日（$355.6）和 100 日均线（$371.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$350.0）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图大致持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$292.08），RSI 为 27，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop lost the $262.3–266.4 support and the $257.8 Nov 2 low, both now resistance, and the $245.9 low tested the Feb 3 low ($246.8). Resistance is $257.8, then $262.3–266.4 and $270.4–274.1 (5-day, Mar 30 low, Nov 3 high). Support is $245.9–246.8, then $238.8–240.7 and $227. A close above $258 would target $262–266; below $245.9, $239–241.

r.en: Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows ($266.4); Mar 9 low $263.0; Feb 4–5 lows ($262.3–263.2)
